---
description: "Use when writing or editing PFM documentation: keep it concise, task-focused and grounded in the code."
applyTo: "**/*.md,**/*.mdx"
---

# Documentation

- Write for the reader's task. Default to a few bullets or short steps.
- Include only necessary prerequisites, commands, warnings and verification.
- Link to authoritative details instead of repeating them.
- Do not narrate implementation inventories, session history or completed work.
- Do not add sections or documents just to describe a small change.
- Use a TL;DR only when the document is substantial.
- Keep screenshots, captions and text alternatives useful and brief.
- For substantive documentation changes, follow the
  [SE: Tech Writer handoff in the specialist table](../../AGENTS.md#specialist-handoffs).
